name: Cut
description: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

name: Fly
description: The user flies up on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

name: Surf
description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

name: Strength
description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

name: Flash
description: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy. It also illuminates caves.

name: Thunderbolt
description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: Flamethrower
description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: Ice Beam
description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

name: Psychic
description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: Earthquake
description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

name: Shadow Ball
description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: Solar Beam
description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

name: Iron Tail
description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

name: Brick Break
description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers like Light Screen and Reflect.

name: Aerial Ace
description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

name: Waterfall
description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb waterfalls.

name: Dive
description: The user dives on the first turn, then hits on the next. It can also be used to dive underwater.

name: Scald
description: The user attacks with boiling hot water. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: Hydro Pump
description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

name: Hyper Beam
description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

name: Facade
description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

name: Dragon Dive
description: The user dives from above with draconic force. Can smash boulders in the overworld.

name: Draco Climb
description: A mystical dragon-powered leap that scales cliffs and tall obstacles.

name: Dragon Claw
description: The user slashes the target with sharp claws infused with draconic energy.

name: Draco Meteor
description: Comets rain down from the sky to strike the target. Harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk.

name: Luster Path
description: The user illuminates a radiant trail that reveals hidden items and paths in dark areas.

name: Shimmer Lift
description: A wave of light lifts the user and allies, allowing traversal over obstacles and terrain.

name: Radiant Beam
description: A piercing beam of light energy that has a high chance to lower the target’s accuracy.

name: Prism Flash
description: The user emits a dazzling flash that may confuse the target and lower their Speed.
